limitations_and_boundaries: Model incorporated information from only two species: human and mouse; including other species may offset benefits due to species-specific expression patterns.
Only four types of prior knowledge included; other essential information such as enhancers and protein sequences could be explored.
Only transcriptional data at single-cell level used; multimodal data (epigenomic, proteomic, metabolomic) would provide richer insights.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

experiments_or_tasks: Constructed scCompass-126M corpus of 126 million human and mouse single-cell transcriptomes; after filtering, retained 101,768,420 cells.
Integrated four types of prior knowledge: GRN, promoter information, gene family annotation, and gene co-expression relationship.
Pre-trained GeneCompass using a 12-layer transformer (L=12, H=12, D=768) with masked language modeling: 15% of genes masked, simultaneous prediction of gene ID and expression value.

methods.name: GeneCompass Architecture
methods.protocol_description: Transformer with L=12, H=12, D=768, total >100M parameters. Input: top 2048 ranked genes per cell, concatenating gene ID, expression value, prior knowledge embeddings, and species token. Position embedding added. GELU activation, dropout 0.02, weight init std 0.02, layer norm epsilon 1e-12. Pre-training: batch size 10, learning rate linear decay with 10,000 warm-up steps, max lr 5e-5, AdamW optimizer, 3 epochs on 4x8 NVIDIA A800 GPUs.
